facts.fact: Zane 拖着沉重的脚步回到自己的卧房，脑子比任何时候都乱；他在想吻过之后还要如何与同住一屋的 Caroline 相处
facts.anchor: My steps were heavy as I entered my bedchamber, my mind more tangled than ever.

facts.fact: Zane 对海滩上那个吻的判语：既太多又不够，是一切
facts.anchor: It had been both too much and not enough. It had been everything.

facts.fact: Zane 打算当天上午就回纽约：她已经安顿好了，他没有留下的理由
facts.anchor: I should return to New York this morning. She was settled. There was no reason for me to stay.

facts.fact: Caroline 半夜从与她卧房相连的门溜进 Zane 的房间，作者比作夜里潜行的贼
facts.anchor: Caroline slip into my room like a thief in the night

facts.fact: Zane 问她是不是走错了房间，她回答自己绝对没有走错地方
facts.anchor: No. I am most definitely in the right place.

facts.fact: Caroline 自称不是初次登场的少女而是离婚女人，明说 Zane 应该知道她要什么
facts.anchor: I’m no debutante. I’m a divorcée. You know what I want.

facts.fact: Caroline 直言要 Zane 帮她把前夫从身上驱逐出去，这是她走进房间的真正目的
Caroline 离开前问「下次能不能让我看看你全身」，把一夜变成一个未结的约
facts.anchor: May I see all of you next time?
